transcript.t: Last Monday, I had to give a speech in English class. I was very nervous the night before.
My hands were cold and I could not sleep well. In the morning, my friend Tom gave me some tips.
He said, take a deep breath, speak slowly, and look at your listeners.
So I stood up, smiled and began. At first my voice shook, but I continued.
After two minutes, I felt calmer. When I finished, everyone clapped.
My teacher said it was a sincere and clear speech. Now I am not so afraid of speaking.
